_help: Leave every value empty until the account exists. Empty values hide the feature: no ad markup, no ads.txt, no newsletter form, and no affiliate tag on product links. When a publisher id and a slot id are both set, that slot is reserved (no layout shift) and the AdSense script loads only after the visitor accepts cookies. Amazon tags: en is the amazon.com associate tag, nl is the amazon.nl associate tag. Newsletter action is the full https URL of the form endpoint; email_field is the input name the provider expects.
